title: Uncalled Helper Functions (Dead Code Utilities)
pattern: Private helper functions or methods that are completely uncalled inside or outside their defining module.
why_bad: It is pure waste. It consumes file space, complicates refactoring, and rots silently without contributing any value.
detection: Private items (lacking `pub`) that have zero local references or call sites.
counterexample: Public APIs or routines designed to be called by external integration tests.
source: Sandi Metz, *Practical Object-Oriented Design* (2019), Chapter 9, p. 179; Robert C. Martin, *Clean Code*, Chapter 17, G9.
